title: Raise
tagline: Decentralise your child’s way of  learning. The foundation phase is an important aspect of your learners' education growth as it impacts their way of learning throughout their education. Give your learners’ a head start in learning confidently and comfortability.
description:
In total, South Africa had 11 252 schools in rural areas across the country and of these, 3 060 were secondary schools and 8 192 were primary schools. The majority of these schools were in the Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, and Limpopo provinces. The country had a total of 5 153 multi-grade schools in the rural areas - 2015 stats



During extensive research, we have found that a majority of Grade 4 learners in these communities are unable to read and write their names with comprehension.



Pupils, families, schools, and the community at large from urban-rural areas will give a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to have a private school simulation in order to help accepted learners flourish in our program. Decentralized learning is included with the platform. This can help the learners easily find new ways of learning, and the platform is tailor-made at an individual level.



The platform will have the ability to notify vendors, sponsors, schools and the parent/guardian of transaction details and any changes and alerts will be sent out using IoT devices. If there are any anomalies with the goods in transit while they are being delivered to the respective school upon successful completion.



An augmented reality experience will help enable the learners to engage more efficiently and not have to wait for practicals to bring things to life.



Personalization that will be tailor-made to meet the needs of each learner. From using artificial intelligence to an in-depth data analytics the assessments will be available at a granular level.
how_its_made: This project use aims to use a browser-based wallet, for a seamless user experience. Tapping into Livepeer's API in order to POST a suitable asset for the kids in rural areas to consume. Leveraging off of SKALE's L2 capabilities and building our incentivized tokens on UMA. Wireframe with Figma in order to tap into the new AWS Amplify Studio functionalities.
